title: BIL Implementability
lede: Whether the Blazing Imaging Library can be built as specified, where it is likely to go wrong, and what to try first.
control: None for Tier 1; M69 to M71 for the C++ interface
Tier 1 reading: NITF, GeoTIFF, JPEG 2000, Source, cache, warnings
footer: BIL Implementability, version 12, an assessment of the Blazing Imaging Library (BIL) specification, first made against version 56 and brought in step with version 81, with what has been built, as of 17 October 2026.
